Zoe (CS): Aurora raised three blocking onboarding issues in today's enablement: relevance drift after bulk ingest, need for per-route cost separation, and silent failures during backfills. Renewal check-in in ~4 weeks. Can product/eng weigh in?
Cal (CS): Quick verbatim notes: 
- "Our search keeps surfacing corporate/legal memos instead of machine specs after we upload our device docs."
- "We need the ability to bill staging vs prod separately; mixing skews our cost reports."
- "Backfill jobs stop without error at ~22k rows; ops had to retry manually and lost progress.\n"
Priyanka (PM): Thanks. My prioritization: relevance drift = P0 (adoption blocker), per-route billing = P1 (commercial impact), backfill robustness = P2 (ops pain).
Diego (ENG): Need a sanitized sample + request ids and ingestion path. Also whether they used our UI or the API.
Zoe (CS): Sharing sanitized example they gave (sanitized):
```
{"text":"Device firmware validation checklist v4","model":"sim-search-2b","metadata":{"customer":"aurora-health"}}
```
They used the UI CSV importer. Example id: aurora-req-2026-11-02-114.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-7219 and linked to ENG-2625.
Priyanka (PM): Proposed plan: 1) ENG triage (48h) to validate vectorization, routing, and fallback mapping (owner: Diego). 2) Product to draft per-route billing RFC and temporary billing-segmentation workaround. 3) CS to gather two more sanitized failing samples and attach impact quotes for the renewal brief.
Diego (ENG): I'll take triage. Plan: reproduce with the sample, compare NN scores across vectorstores, check tokenizer edge-cases, and confirm whether fallback mapping is misassigning model variants. Will update here within 48h.
Cal (CS): I'll ask Aurora for permission to run a quick mitigation on a small dataset (domain-specific tokenization + higher similarity threshold) and schedule a 20-min follow-up.
Zoe (CS): I'll include this in the renewal risk memo and flag per-route billing as a potential negotiation lever if we can't fix relevance quickly. Link to internal notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/aurora-onboard-11-2026 (internal).
Priyanka (PM): If ENG finds routing bug, we fast-track a patch; otherwise we'll propose a config surface to pin model for CSV imports. Keep CS-7219 updated with repro artifacts.
Diego (ENG): Starting repro now. Posting interim findings ASAP.
Zoe (CS): Thanks — leaving this open until triage posts results. :thumbsup:
